status: Published yearly-upfront and higher monthly-instalment prices. Both options require 12 months. Authorized interactive basket/checkout preview; accounts, payment and entitlements remain inactive.
decision: Core: €2,988 paid yearly (€249/month equivalent), or €299/month for 12 months (€3,588). Expand: €2,388/location paid yearly (€199/location/month equivalent), or €239/location/month for 12 months, minimum two locations. Enterprise contact sales. Prices exclude VAT.
rationale: Free fictional exploration supports evaluation without unpaid implementation work.
Two publicly priced plans support self-guided adoption. Larger footprints require a sales discussion without promising bespoke implementation or a staffed service.
Package differences reflect location capacity, comparisons and data allowances, rather than consulting hours or account management.
Guided setup and documentation are included; managed setup, migration and custom development are not offered as add-ons in these packages.
Evidence review and customer control remain common to every plan.
Usage and processing costs need explicit budgets. No unlimited media processing or support is promised.

The user explicitly authorized a browser-only checkout preview and confirmed both schedules have a 12-month commitment, with yearly upfront payments cheaper. Yearly rates preserve the preceding prices; monthly instalments increase to €299 Core and €239/location Expand.

costFloor.recurring: minimum monthly-equivalent subscription = monthly direct delivery cost / (1 - target recurring gross margin)
recurringCostInputs: Model/API usage and third-party data costs
Founder support and operating time valued at a realistic hourly rate
Payment processing and direct recurring service costs
costFloor.setup: Standard guided-setup cost is included in acquisition/activation economics; bespoke setup services are not sold.
costFloor.cacPaybackMonths: (acquisition cost + unrecovered standard activation cost) / monthly recurring gross profit
costFloor.grossProfit: Subscription revenue less direct recurring delivery costs. This excludes R&D, general overhead and taxes and is not net profit.
costFloor.constraint: The price must also pass willingness-to-pay and evidenced customer-value validation; a cost floor alone does not prove demand or profitability.

sensitivityExamples.label: Illustrative arithmetic in arbitrary currency units. These are invented cost scenarios, not proposed public prices or measured RADR margins.

validationBeforeNumericPricing: Confirm willingness to pay and direct delivery costs at the published rates before paid activation.
Measure processing, model, storage, payment and founder-time costs under the included allowances.
Set and enforce model-request, media and refresh budgets separately from imported-row limits.
Confirm upgrade, limit, cancellation and renewal behavior before live subscriptions.
Test whether customers can complete setup using product guidance without a staffed onboarding process.

marketEvidence.observation: Quotes depend on module selection and customer requirements.
Per-room basis and tailored quotes; some add-ons and payment processing are separate.
Starter, Growth and Premium packages with quote CTAs and separately described add-ons.
Public tier ladder with defined invoice/integration allowances and priced add-ons.
Custom quote based on the selected restaurant software scope.

evidenceLimits: Public pricing pages only; no access to competitor contracts, discounts, margins or internal costs. No claim that all providers prohibit trials.
quoteReviewRules: Validate cost per account and per included location at typical and high usage.
Do not treat founder support or setup time as zero because there is no employee payroll.
Record allowance alone does not control model, media or refresh costs. Enforce resource budgets before paid activation.

Yearly upfront pricing is lower than monthly instalments. Show the full upfront amount, minimum locations, 12-month commitment, total contract value, VAT treatment and actual monetary savings before purchase.
Do not add bespoke support or implementation promises to close a sale without revising the operating model.
Measure conversion, setup completion and support requests alongside margin.
founderConstraint: No employees or customer-success team. Do not sell a staffed service, unlimited support, bespoke data cleanup, custom connector projects or guaranteed response times.

recurringModel.structure: Per-location subscription with two publicly priced plans; Enterprise scope and price agreed with sales.
recurringModel.billing: Both options: 12-month commitment. Yearly upfront at €249 Core/month equivalent and €199 Expand/location/month equivalent. Monthly instalments at €299 Core and €239/location Expand. No cancel-monthly plan is offered.
recurringModel.setup: Standard guided setup included without a setup fee
recurringModel.support: Documentation and product guidance. No CSM, staffed onboarding or SLA promise.
recurringModel.growth: Expand charges €199 per contracted location/month for 2–5 locations. Enterprise is contact sales for 6+ or nonstandard usage. Contract, upgrade, renewal and cancellation rules require review before activation.
recurringModel.limits: Numeric allowances are pending. Document and enforce them before paid activation; a package preview is not a processing benchmark.

profitabilityGuardrails.meaning: Illustrative cost ceilings at the target gross margin, including usage, infrastructure, payment fees and valued delivery/support time; not measured costs or guaranteed profit.
profitabilityGuardrails.commercialReadiness: Usage allowances, merchant identity, contract terms, real authentication, email and payment services must be ready before paid activation.

checkoutPreview.personalDetailsStorage: In current tab React memory only; never sent to an API, localStorage or sessionStorage. Cleared on reload or removal. URL persists only plan, billing, locations and optional demo vertical.
checkoutPreview.accountState: Not signed in. Create/sign-in controls are illustrated, password inputs disabled. No account or session is created.
checkoutPreview.cardState: Disabled fields. No card collection, no payment request, no order or entitlement. Purchase button always disabled.
checkoutPreview.businessValidation: Completeness and conservative format validation, not company registry, identity or VAT verification.

checkoutPreview.inputQualityChecks: Reject known placeholders including common legal-suffix variants, repeated junk/all-zero references, URLs in identity/address fields, hidden formatting characters, known disposable or reserved email domains and their subdomains. Conservative checks do not prove identity.
checkoutPreview.transitionGuards: Step navigation and company submission recheck prerequisites in their handlers, independently of disabled/required HTML attributes. These are preview checks, not a server authorization boundary.
